## Preflight

- Design frozen before cells: `DESIGN.md`.
- Dry-run count: `scripts/campaign describe` reports 8 blocks, array=1 each (8 cells), matching `DESIGN.md`.
- Local smoke (2026-11-16, reduced 2 epochs / 100 agents, seed 1030001, `single_line_receipt`): both arms wrote the unchanged zip contract (`summary.json`, `growth_census.json.gz`, `rss_samples.json`); `mechanisms.provisioned_source` resolved `lot_layer_mode=single_line_receipt`, `n_contaminated=1`, shellfish, `actual_venues_used=['MainDining_L']`.
- Engine readback (same smoke path, 1 epoch / 20 agents): captured `TransmissionCore` attributes `('shedders_only','legacy',1,'hygiene_cycle')` and `('carriers','legacy',1,'hygiene_cycle')`, proving the redeposit override reaches the engine and leaves order/substeps/hygiene at defaults.
- Image digest: `picard-campaign:noro-supply-redeposit01@sha256:ae8f91c9d95b3dec6c23da17faef94e024741caf7a86b39d2e47fdc3a5b90673`; in-container `ENGINE_GIT_SHA=7a3d3d7828dd34f96c58b10a75fe040b19ffde5a`, manifest/worker/entrypoint present.
- Jobdef revisions: canary `:1`; single-job submissions `:3`-`:9`. Revision `:2` was registered during a rejected array-size-1 submit attempt and has no job.
- Canary: `meg_single_line_receipt_1030001_carriers`, job `8ac43758-bfa5-4a1c-99f4-b2e4d33695d2`, jobdef `:1`, succeeded. Artifact contract intact (`summary.json`, `growth_census.json.gz`, `rss_samples.json`); supply witness `single_line_receipt`, shellfish, `MainDining_L`, `n_contaminated=1`. Derived endpoints: `outbreak_occurred=true`, `vsp_trigger_epoch=null`, passenger reported-case AR 0.0286, crew reported-case AR 0.0214, overall attack rate 0.0821.
- Remaining submissions used `--canary --index 0` because AWS Batch rejects array size 1; each is a single job, not an array.

## Readout summary

All eight cells succeeded on `ENGINE_GIT_SHA=7a3d3d7828dd34f96c58b10a75fe040b19ffde5a`. `shedders_only` posted 4/4 seeds; `carriers` posted 1/4 (only station_lots seed 1020931, VSP epoch 60 vs 59). Passenger reported-case AR fell on every pair (-0.74 to -2.35 pp), passenger infection AR by -2.75 to -7.45 pp, and overall AR by -0.19 to -6.72 pp; `census.n_acquired` fell on every pair while `n_imports` stayed fixed. Receipt-arm provisioned event dose matched the frozen ranking burden exactly; station-lot `lot_servings`/`lot_titre_gec_per_g` stayed paired but per-pan serving-mass draws and credited dose were not bit-identical. Canonical readout: `docs/ledger/FOOD-SUPPLY-01-REDEPOSIT-WORST.md`.
